1. WHO MAY DISCLOSE

I authorize Ridgeway Valley Pediatric Associates, PC to disclose the health information described below.

2. WHO MAY RECEIVE

I authorize the disclosure to be made to: ____________________________________________
Address: ____________________________________________

3. WHAT MAY BE DISCLOSED

The following information, described specifically and meaningfully:

Office visit notes for the period ____________________ through ____________________
Immunization record
Growth chart
Laboratory and imaging results
Other, described here: ____________________________________________

I understand that records about mental health treatment, substance use disorder treatment, HIV or AIDS testing or treatment, and genetic testing are released only if I initial beside them: ____

4. WHY IT IS BEING DISCLOSED

Purpose of the disclosure: ____________________________________________
If I do not wish to state a purpose, I may write "at my request."

5. WHEN THIS AUTHORIZATION ENDS

This authorization expires on ____________________, or on the occurrence of the following event: ____________________________________________. If I write nothing, it expires one year from the date I sign it.

6. MY RIGHT TO REVOKE

I may revoke this authorization at any time by giving written notice to the Privacy Officer at the address above. The revocation takes effect when it is received, except to the extent the practice has already acted in reliance on this authorization.

7. TREATMENT IS NOT CONDITIONED ON THIS AUTHORIZATION

The practice may not condition my treatment, payment, enrollment in a health plan, or eligibility for benefits on whether I sign this authorization.

8. INFORMATION MAY BE REDISCLOSED

I understand that information disclosed under this authorization may be redisclosed by the recipient and may then no longer be protected by the federal privacy regulations.

9. COPY

I am entitled to a copy of this signed authorization.
